events.title: Bloom & Connect

events.title: Glow & Grow

events.description: Blend your own fragrance and pour a soy wax candle to take home, with a food tasting from a local producer running alongside.

events.title: Draw & Deal
events.subtitle: Neurographic art and speed networking
events.description: A guided drawing session using a calm, structured technique, then a speed-meeting round that gives everyone a real introduction.

services.name: Content Club
services.tagline: A month of content in two hours
services.description: Two hours in the studio with Lilija on hand for ideas, framing and what to say on camera. Come with nothing planned.

services.name: The Podcast Room
services.description: Tuesday is podcast day and nothing else is booked in. An audio operator is on site for every session.

services.name: Studio Hire

services.name: The Workshop
